# Client Chat Platform Copilot Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `evavo.reliability.json` and the security and storage contracts.

This repository is an active commercial portfolio slot. Use Development Studio `portfolio:decision` before feature work and publish only through `mainline-publish` with `repository-main:EVAVO-STUDIO/client-chat-platform`. Do not create branches, pull requests or another repository.

Keep origin approval separate from authorization, reject wildcard credentialed origins, preserve tenant boundaries, bound every request and keep provider credentials out of the widget and logs. Source, Wrangler dry run, origin/CORS, storage/retention, widget browser, production Worker and rollback are separate exact-SHA evidence contexts under `evavo/evidence/<id>`.
